column1: # Russian stress for the reels' voice-over. "+" goes before the stressed vowel; stress.py turns it into
# a combining acute accent, which Eleven v4 reads as the stress (checked 22.11.2026 with forced wrong stress).
# Keys are lower case. A key with a space is a phrase override for a word whose stress depends on context;
# phrases are applied before single words. Words with «ё» and one-syllable words need no entry.
# `python ads/audio/tts.py <reel> --stress` lists the reel's words that are missing here.
